name: OwlKitty
bio: OwlKitty (legal name: Lizzy) is Hollywood's hardest-working actress, having appeared in Titanic, Jurassic Park, and The Lord of the Rings — all decades after they were filmed, thanks to a VFX-artist owner and a green screen in the living room. She works for treats, scale.
awards: Best Supporting Actress in films she was never cast in
